race.comment: BOHEMIAN BLITZ (1) has provided two nice efforts to date. He is probably bred to want a little further but they may just ride him a bit more conservatively early to be strong late. Should at least run another honest race. GENKI GIRL (15) took on two better standard maidens to begin her career and then was favourite at Bairnsdale. Suspect the 1200m of this race is of far better liking. SATOSHI (6) is beautifully bred but potentially is suited to wanting more ground not less. He showed enough speed so far that that could play a role in this. FREWDAMOSS (7) is definitely one to watch given the standard of the maidens and that she has had three trials.
